weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入天秤座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往天秤座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 今天，白羊座，你可能會感覺到你開朗的態度沒有被周圍的人擁抱。感覺就像一片負面情緒籠罩在人們的反應上，使他們抵抗任何正面情緒。但是，不要讓這種情況影響你的精神！保持自己的快樂是至關重要的。此時請盡量不要深入探究他人行為背後的動機。
aries.horoscope_en: Today, Aries, you might sense that your cheerful demeanor isn't being embraced by those around you. It could feel like a cloud of negativity is hanging over people's reactions, making them resistant to any positivity. However, don't allow this to dampen your spirits! It's crucial to keep your own joy intact. Try not to delve too deeply into the motivations behind others' actions at this time.

taurus.horoscope: 今天，金牛座必須密切關注細節，因為即使是最微小的細節也可能產生重大影響。如果感覺不對勁，請相信自己的直覺，不要忽視這些感覺。保持專注，並為可能打亂您心靈平靜的意外情緒事宜做好準備。最重要的是，無論周圍的混亂如何，都要對自己有信心。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, it's essential to pay close attention to the finer points, as even the tiniest detail could have a significant impact. If something feels off, trust your instincts and don't ignore those feelings. Maintain your concentration and be prepared for unexpected emotional matters that may disrupt your peace of mind. Above all, have faith in yourself, no matter the chaos that may surround you.

gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you might sense a feeling of being trapped with no way out. However, don't lose hope over what appears to be an impossible situation. Imagine yourself as a skilled magician capable of breaking free from even the toughest restraints. You possess clever solutions that can help you navigate through any challenge that comes your way.

cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, now is the moment to assert your position on a matter that you've been uncertain about recently. If you continue to waver, others may start to doubt your resolve. Little do they know, you've been diligently sorting through all the details. It's time to articulate your insights and share what you've learned.

leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you might find yourself overflowing with excitement to share some thrilling news with your friends. Whether it's a significant delivery or a vital piece of information, your enthusiasm is palpable. Just be cautious about your surroundings, as there may be some ears nearby that aren't looking out for your best interests.

virgo.horoscope: 今天，處女座，你猶豫不決地發表你的想法可能會導致並發症。你可能會因為擔心別人的意見而拒絕提供資訊。重要的是要認識到，這可能是您自己不願參與的掩蓋。敞開心扉並分享您的見解，您會對回饋給您的智慧感到驚喜。請記住，在等待交換時，可能需要耐心等待。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, your hesitation to voice your thoughts might lead to complications. You may find yourself holding back information due to concerns about others' opinions. It's important to recognize that this could be a cover for your own reluctance to engage. By opening up and sharing your insights, you'll be pleasantly surprised by the wisdom that flows back to you. Just remember, patience may be required as you await this exchange.

libra.horoscope: 今天，天秤座，你可能會發現自己與年長的人處於一種對峙狀態。似乎有人正在採取「父母最了解」的態度，這可能是你的皮膚。花點時間停下來深呼吸。請記住，此人不是試圖批評您，他們只是提供指導。保持開放的心態，因為他們的見解可能非常有益。
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, you might find yourself in a bit of a standoff with an older individual. It seems like someone is taking on a "parent knows best" attitude, which could be getting under your skin. Take a moment to pause and breathe. Remember, this person isn't trying to criticize you; they're simply offering guidance. Keep an open mind, as their insights could prove to be quite beneficial.

scorpio.horoscope_en: Today brings a sense of comfort that will envelop you, Scorpio, instilling a feeling of safety and care. You might sense a powerful force—perhaps from within—that reassures you that as long as you adhere to the rules, all will be well. The familiarity of your surroundings will help you smoothly sail through any challenges that may arise.

sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, Sagittarius, you might find yourself navigating a complex maze, feeling trapped by walls and winding paths that lead you in circles. Rather than continuing to roam without purpose, take a moment to seek guidance. If you lift your gaze, you'll discover wise souls above who are eager to share their insights from a higher vantage point.

capricorn.horoscope: 今天，要小心，不要過於僵化你的信仰，堅持你擁有唯一有效的觀點。在做出任何承諾之前，請務必探索所有可能性。如果你仍然不靈活，你周圍的人可能會對你有限的觀點感到沮喪。花點時間後退一步，評估更廣泛的情況，以避免被這樣看待。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, be cautious not to become too rigid in your beliefs, insisting that you have the only valid perspective. It's essential to explore all possibilities before making any commitments. If you remain inflexible, those around you may grow frustrated with your limited viewpoint. Take a moment to step back and assess the broader situation to avoid being perceived this way.

aquarius.horoscope: 如果事情沒有如你所願地展開，水瓶座，請考慮退一步，讓活動發揮作用。即使您認為自己擁有完美的解決方案，也要避免幹涉他人事務的誘惑。你周圍的人可能有堅定的信念，他們不太可能改變主意。改為專注於自己的福祉；這可能意味著暫時採取更安靜、更私密的方法。
aquarius.horoscope_en: If things aren't unfolding as you wish, Aquarius, consider taking a step back and letting events play out. Avoid the temptation to interfere in others' affairs, even if you believe you have the perfect solution. People around you may hold firm beliefs, and it's unlikely they'll change their minds. Focus on your own well-being instead; this might mean embracing a quieter, more private approach for the time being.

pisces.horoscope_en: Pisces, it seems you've found yourself caught in a whirlwind of thoughts regarding recent events. Your mind is likely racing as you try to piece everything together. However, the truth might be that you're blowing things out of proportion. Today, you may confront the sobering truth that stems from your tendency to overthink.
